title: DeepONet branch/trunk Mirror role sharing
hypothesis: One shared latent map plus small role-specific orthogonal View codes preserves branch/trunk functions and composed operator quality with fewer bytes than untied role maps, and adds value beyond ordinary tied maps, output FiLM, and direct native Givens coordinates.
physical_object: shared linear latent map from 8-dimensional role features to a 4-dimensional DeepONet factor
logical_multiplicity: 8 synthetic operator domains with separate branch and trunk roles
controls: untied per-domain branch and trunk maps

development.selection_metric: held-out branch/trunk factor nRMSE, composed operator nRMSE, actual complete serialized bytes

fresh.reason: no audit after exact native direct-Givens alias

storage.authority: actual serialized complete inference payload bytes

success_gate: Mirror role codes meet factor and composed operator nRMSE <=.02, save >=25% bytes vs untied controls, and strictly improve the quality/byte frontier over direct native Givens and FiLM controls.
failure_gate: Quality miss, <25% savings, or exact native Givens function/payload alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Synthetic role-aligned linear latent maps only.
No trained DeepONet, PDE, natural sensing or language claim.
No optimization, fresh world, or hardware runtime claim.
